summary: The agent demonstrates strong modeling skills, including sophisticated feature engineering, deep learning architecture, and optimized ensembling. However, there are multiple data leakage issues. Imputation, PCA (TruncatedSVD), and frequency encodings are improperly applied to the full training set before cross-validation splits.
